versions.changelog:
- Initial release of /linkedin-search: an automated LinkedIn candidate search workflow.
- Adds a multi-phase requirement clarification step before searching to ensure precise criteria.
- Distinguishes between hard and soft candidate requirements, allowing user confirmation and adjustment.
- Separates search parameters (job keywords/location) from LLM-analyzed parameters (experience, relevance, etc.).
- Implements pre-checks for Chrome DevTools session and LinkedIn login before execution.
- Prevents duplicate scanning by saving candidate profiles to role-based folders.
